bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs, springboard/render/src/ui.rs, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs, springboard/ui/src/panels.rs, springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/sdk/src/image_object.rs, springboard/sdk/src/color_list.rs, springboard/ui/src/color_well.rs, springboard/ui/src/printer_caps.rs
summary: Semantic colours (every catalogue name, measured from the reference appearance catalogues, with lookup by name), a colour panel with picker modes, mask, continuity and slider components, a colour well control with the shared-panel protocol and a colour-list swatch popover, colour spaces and lists, PNG/JPEG/GIF/TIFF and other codecs, an NSImage-style object with per-codec representations that draws itself in a tint, at an opacity and as nine slices, procedural symbol glyphs, a software 2D Surface and Canvas, and CUPS printing with printer device descriptions. Missing: on-screen colour well and pickers in the shell, the eyedropper, the Page Setup sheet, re-valued legacy colour pairs, the symbol catalogue.

features.feature: Images and PDF: image objects and representations
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/image_object.rs (ImageObject, ImageRep, ImageCatalog, tint_template); springboard/sdk/src/image_source.rs (representation); springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (Image); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-09.rs; springboard/sdk/src/image_object.rs (ImageObject::draw, ImageRep::codec, frame_count, is_animated)
features.note: ImageObject holds bitmap and vector representations, picks the best one for a target size and scale, keeps a point size, a template flag and cap insets, and computes nine-slice layouts; ImageCatalog registers named images and tint_template draws a template in a tint, all tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-09.rs. Gap: there are no representation classes per codec (no TIFF, GIF, WebP or HEIC rep), and the kit's image widgets do not yet use the tint; the drawn result needs Midget. Built 2026-10-24: ImageObject::draw draws the decoded pixels on any Canvas, a template as a mask in the context tint (opacity scales the mask), other images as themselves, and cap insets as nine slices; ImageRep records its codec (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF, WebP) and frame count, and from_encoded gives icons and multi-page TIFFs one representation per image and animations one with their frames; pixel tests in image_object::tests. So the tint is drawn and codec representations exist. Still missing: file DPI (72 dpi kept), HEIC, and a kit widget that takes an ImageObject. Midget check: none visible yet; host tests.

Fixed set of 60 procedural line glyphs (glyphs::NAMES), one weight, no hierarchical or palette rendering (docs/bifrost-ui.md). Every name is drawn headless into an offscreen surface in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-w7.rs; the symbol set's names and code points are tested in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-w7.rs.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (open a PDF for pages, size and a rasterised page; writer); springboard/ui/src/pdfpage.rs (page boxes, rotation, aspect-fit); springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/mod.rs
features.note: Apps can open a PDF to read its page count, page sizes and rasterised pages through the SDK, and the page geometry is tested in pdfpage. Gap: text extraction and annotation editing stay in the PDF app, and the Books engine keeps its own parser. Refreshed 2026-10-17: SDK access is covered by springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (open, page count and sizes, outline, find, page text); tests graphics_pdf::tests. Still missing: annotation editing, and the Books engine keeps its own parser.

features.feature: Images and PDF: file and app icons
features.note: Icon glyph names follow the content type of a file, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-09.rs; the folder icon is procedural. Gap: the glyphs are names that the kit draws, not a set of per-type drawn icons, and app icons are not loaded from bundles.

features.feature: Drawing: 2D drawing context and basic shapes
features.apple: NSGraphicsContext, NSRectFill, NSBezierPath fill/stroke of rects and rounded rects
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (Surface, fill_rrect, rrect_coverage, Damage); springboard/render/src/clip.rs (ClipStack, fill_clipped); springboard/render/src/affine.rs (Affine, TransformStack); springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-09.rs
features.note: software Surface with rect, rounded rect, squircle masks and damage tracking; nested clip rectangles (ClipStack) and affine transforms with a save and restore stack (TransformStack) are tested headless. Gap: Surface draws take no clip or transform itself, so apps apply them before drawing, and clipping paths other than rectangles are not modelled. Refreshed 2026-10-24: the Canvas trait over Surface (springboard/render/src/canvas.rs, push_clip, push_transform, push_opacity) does apply rounded-rect clips, transforms and opacity to every draw, so only clipping paths other than (rounded) rectangles remain unmodelled.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/drawing_model.rs (BezierPath, Gradient, ShadowStyle, PageLayout), springboard/render/src/bezier.rs, springboard/render/src/gradient.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/layer_style.rs (Shadow, used by style.rs); wired: springboard/ui/src/layer_style.rs (Shadow::radius) via springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/style.rs (blur_taps, paint_with_blur); springboard/sdk/src/drawing_model.rs (BezierPath::stroke, fill_with_shadow, stroke_with_shadow, Gradient::draw_in_path, draw_in_rect, draw_radial_in_path, ShadowStyle::effect)
features.note: BezierPath construction, bounds, winding-rule containment, fills, strokes and clipping (pixel-exact on the graphics context), Gradient stops and offsets, ShadowStyle extent and PageLayout pagination are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs (drawing module). Gaps: dash and cap/join styles are stored but not rendered; image representations, colour space lists and the modal print run remain missing; wired into the UI in waves 5 and 6, not yet verified on Midget. Refreshed 2026-10-17: the public API is covered by springboard/sdk/src/drawing_model.rs (BezierPath, Gradient, ShadowStyle, PageLayout); tests drawing_model::tests. Built 2026-10-19: BezierPath::stroke now renders the path's line cap, join, miter limit and dash pattern (they were stored but ignored) through the graphics context and puts the context's own line settings back; Gradient::draw_in_path / draw_in_rect fill a path or rect with a linear gradient at an angle and draw_radial_in_path with a relative centre, clipped to the path under its winding rule; BezierPath::fill_with_shadow and stroke_with_shadow cast a ShadowStyle under the shape. Pixel tests in drawing_model.rs (dash gaps, square cap reach, gradient end colours, oval clip, radial centre, shadow offset). Still missing: image representations and the modal print run. Midget check: no shell screen draws these yet, so the lead runs the sdk drawing_model tests on the host; on Midget, any app that strokes a dashed BezierPath shows the dashes.
glass hook and light/dark cross-fade exist; Spotlight blur still missing per CLAUDE.md
retained views with damage rects; not the NSView draw cycle or NSCell model

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/gpu_layer.rs (drawable layer for apps, from bifrost_ui::drawable_layer); springboard/ui/src/drawable_layer.rs (DrawableLayer: drawables, present, recycle); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs, docs/gpu-first.md
features.note: Apps get a drawable layer that hands presented frames to the shell and converts them to images, tested inline in the drawable_layer model. Gap: apps have no GPU command or shader API, and the presenter that scans frames out stays in the shell.

features.apple: NSColor named colours, systemRed..systemGray, labelColor, controlAccentColor
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/ui.rs (mod system), docs/bifrost-ui.md section NSColor semantic colours; springboard/render/src/ui.rs (system::CONTROL ... QUINARY_SYSTEM_FILL, ALTERNATING_CONTENT_BACKGROUNDS, NAMED, named)
features.note: most named colours as light/dark Pairs; windowFrameColor, findHighlightColor and shadowColor added (WINDOW_FRAME, FIND_HIGHLIGHT, SHADOW; findHighlight values are an approximation to confirm on Midget); user accent colour not wired; remaining NSColor names missing built on parity/team-k-appkit-graphics-printing; not yet verified on Midget. Built 2026-10-24: the remaining names (control, control text, disabled control text, selected control and text, unemphasized selected text, keyboard focus indicator, text insertion point, header text, selected menu item text, highlight, window frame text, quinary label, the five system fills, alternating content backgrounds, control shadow and highlight edges) with values measured from the reference light and dark appearance catalogues, stored premultiplied, and system::named(name) / NAMED to look a dynamic colour up by its catalogue name; tests ui::system::tests. The user accent already feeds controlAccentColor (Pair::following_accent, ToApp::Appearance), so that gap was stale. FIND_HIGHLIGHT is premultiplied now (it drew too bright). Still missing: the existing pairs (labels, window background, link, the 26A434 system colours) differ from the measured values and were not re-valued (lead decision with a Midget comparison), and the focus ring does not take the accent. Midget check: none visible yet; the lead runs the render ui::system tests on the host.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/panels.rs (ColorPanel); springboard/ui/src/panels.rs (PanelMode, PanelModes, set_mode, set_mask, shows_alpha, is_continuous, track_rgb, attach_color_list, components, set_component); springboard/ui/src/color_well.rs (ColorWell, WellStyle, ColorWells, SwatchGrid, draw_well)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. RGB plus alpha model with change callback; no colour well control, no picker modes (wheel, sliders, palettes, crayons) Built 2026-10-24: picker modes with the reference raw values (none -1 ... crayon 7) and the picker mask (a hidden picker moves to the first allowed), showsAlpha (default off), isContinuous with drag steps, attached colour lists, and slider components for grey, RGB, CMYK and HSB; a colour well control in the default, minimal and expanded styles with exclusive and additive activation, panel changes reaching active wells, takeColorFrom and drops, style clicks (panel toggle, swatch popover, expanded panel button), the popover swatch grid and draw_well; tests panels::tests and color_well::tests. Still missing: no shell screen draws the pickers or hosts a well, crayon and custom palette pickers have no content, no eyedropper. Midget check: none visible yet; host tests.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/color_list.rs (ColorList, ColorLists); springboard/sdk/src/graphics_color.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-09.rs; springboard/sdk/src/color_list.rs (ColorList::system, swatches, apply_to_panel, to_text, from_text, ColorLists::standard); springboard/sdk/src/color_list.rs (swatch_grid, pick_into_well)
features.note: Colour spaces and conversions are in graphics_color (bifrost_render::cg::color, ICC profiles for apps). ColorList and ColorLists add NSColorList: ordered named colours with a registry by name, and a colour can be moved to a new position; tested headless. Gap: no colour well or picker uses the lists and there is no eyedropper, which need the Midget display. Built 2026-10-19: the System list holds the 13 named system colours in their light or dark values and every registry can start with it (ColorLists::standard); swatches() gives a colour well its keys and 8-bit colours, and apply_to_panel(key, panel) sets the colour panel's colour and opacity as picking a swatch does; to_text and from_text save and read a list as a text file (damaged lines are skipped). Still missing: no colour well in the shell draws the swatches and there is no eyedropper. Midget check: no visible screen yet; the lead runs the sdk color_list tests on the host, and on Midget an app that opens the colour panel and calls ColorList::system(false).apply_to_panel("Green", &mut panel) shows the panel on (52, 199, 89). Built 2026-10-24: a colour well popover takes its swatch grid from a list (swatch_grid) and picking a swatch sets the well, and the panel when the well is active (pick_into_well); the panel keeps attached list names (attach_color_list). Still missing: a shell-drawn well and popover, and the eyedropper.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/print.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (Job, Layout, paper and scale) over springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/ui/src/print_pages.rs (PdfContext, PrintableView, paginate); springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (SIDES, Setup::sides and mono, to_grey)
features.note: paper, orientation, margins, copies, page range, scaling_factor and job_disposition (spool, save, preview); PrintOperation::print_operation(view) paginates a PrintableView (knows_page_range, rect_for_page, or tiles) and draws it into a PDF through PdfContext (fills, paths, text, images); pdf_operation(view, rect, path); run_modal with shows_print_panel and did_run; submits via IPP or saves the PDF. Host tests only: pages are drawn when the operation is made, no rich text or font embedding (Helvetica only), no clipping or transforms beyond the page tile; verify on Midget for parity. Sides and colour are in PrintInfo and sent as job attributes (non-default only); a page range cuts the view's pages once (render_pages); print_ranges parses typed page lists. Still no shell sheet rows for them. Built 2026-10-19: the shell print sheet now has Sides (One-sided, Two-sided, Two-sided short edge) and Colour (Colour, Black & White) rows that fill PrintInfo.sides and PrintInfo.color, so the IPP job carries sides and print-color-mode; Black & White also greys the pages (luminance) so a Save as PDF job is monochrome. Midget check: open any app, File > Print, tap the Sides row until Two-sided and the Colour row to Black & White, pick Save as PDF as the printer and press Print; Documents gets a PDF whose pages are grey.

features.feature: Printing: print panel, page layout, accessory views
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/print_panel.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (sheet rows: printer, paper, orientation, scale, copies); accessory views not done, springboard/ui/src/print_pages.rs; springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (rows Sides and Colour)
features.note: print_panel.rs adds PanelOptions (showsCopies, page range, paper size, orientation, scaling, preview, print selection) whose apply() writes a PanelRequest into the print info and refuses hidden controls, and PageSetup (paper, orientation, margins, scale) that round-trips with the print info; plug-in panels (accessory controllers) are keyed models. The shell sheet builds its PrintInfo through the defaults; the scale row and a shell-drawn page layout panel are not wired; verify on Midget for parity. print_presets (PresetStore) keeps named page setups with a text form; the shell sheet does not show presets, the PDF popup or Page Setup yet. Built 2026-10-19: the sheet rows now include Pages, Sides and Colour next to printer, paper, orientation, scale and copies (the card is taller to hold them). Still missing: the Page Setup panel, presets and accessory views in the shell. Midget check: File > Print on Midget shows eight rows: Printer, Paper, Orientation, Scale, Copies, Pages, Sides, Colour, and each cycles when tapped.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/cups.rs, springboard/ui/src/printer_caps.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/print_sheet.rs (printers and targets) over springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/ui/src/printer_caps.rs (imageable_rect); springboard/ui/src/printer_caps.rs (make_and_model, formats, resolutions, default_resolution, language_level, device_description, DeviceDescription)
features.note: cups::Client::printers() lists queues; get_printer_attributes() reads capabilities (printer_caps.rs: PWG paper list with PPD names, duplex, colour modes, default media, status and reasons, Letter/A4 fallback, hardware margins from media-*-margin-supported); paper_size_in_points and imageable_rect(name) give paperSize(forPaperName:) and the printable rect; print panel not yet using them; deviceDescription and languageLevel missing; verify on Midget for parity. Built 2026-10-24: make and model (type), accepted document formats, resolutions in dpi (IPP resolution values, dots per centimetre converted) with a default, language_level (3 for a PostScript-capable queue, else 0) and device_description (printer, resolution, default paper size, RGB or grey, 8 bits per sample); tests printer_caps::tests. So deviceDescription and languageLevel are no longer missing. Still missing: the print sheet does not use the capability lists. Midget check: with a CUPS queue on Midget, Client::get_printer_attributes(name).device_description() reports the queue resolution.

features.feature: Visual effect material catalogue and blending (sidebar, titlebar, menu, popover, HUD, sheet, header, window and content backgrounds; behind- and within-window)
features.note: The 14-material catalogue, its window-server wire values, blur and tint rules, and within- and behind-window drawing are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05.rs with pixel assertions on an offscreen surface. Gap: the per-shader inventory from macOS 27 Golden Gate 26A434 (docs/macos-os-inventory.md) is not yet extracted.

Glass shapes group by proximity for a glass container (group_shapes, joins transitively within a spacing), and the glass material compares every parameter, tested headless. Gap: the per-shader inventory comes from macOS 27 Golden Gate 26A434 (InstallAssistant.pkg, extraction in docs/macos-os-inventory.md), and the container blend needs the Midget display to check.

gaps: Page Setup and accessory views: the shell print sheet has printer, paper, orientation, scale, copies, pages, sides and colour rows, but no page layout panel and no accessory view controllers (print_panel.rs PageSetup is a model only); the sheet does not read the printer capability lists.

Colour well and pickers on screen: the well, picker modes and colour-list popover are models with drawing (ui/src/color_well.rs, ui/src/panels.rs), but no shell screen hosts them; no eyedropper; crayon and custom palette pickers have no content.

Semantic colour values: every name exists (render/src/ui.rs system::NAMED), but the older pairs (labels, window background, link, system colours) differ from the measured 26A434 values and await a lead re-valuing decision.
Images: file DPI, HEIC and a kit widget that takes an ImageObject.
Symbol catalogue beyond the procedural glyphs; clipping paths other than rounded rectangles.
